text_block_list.text: One day, after training—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Where's my bottle? Did I leave it 
on the training course?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Trainer. I'll be heading home 
after I go grab my water bottle.
choice_data_list: It's already dark, so I'll come with you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You think so? Sorry about that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, it should have 
been placed over there—

text_block_list.name: Spirited Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, my race is coming up soon. So 
stop bothering me and go away already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? In your way...? You're the one who 
showed up after me, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No, I had no idea you were even here. Just 
hurry up and get going already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Tch, don't mess with me...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems so. I'll go check on them for 
a bit."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"As far as I am aware, there were no 
restrictions placed on using this course 
today."

text_block_list.name: Spirited Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What's with you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hayahide...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Did some kind of circumstance require 
temporary restrictions on its use?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Then leave Taishin's matter to me, I'll 
negotiate it. Just tell me who I need 
permission from."

text_block_list.name: Spirited Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh, no... not really—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, what? You mean temporary permission 
isn't necessary?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then why did you demand that Taishin step 
down? Did she make any kind of mistake?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If there was any fault on my part, such as 
interference, please let me know.

text_block_list.name: Spirited Umamusume
text_block_list.text: T-That's...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? Were you just 
complaining without any real reason to 
begin with?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, it seems to me that the 
fault lies with your side for trying to 
unfairly push someone off the course."

text_block_list.name: Spirited Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Tch...... whatever, fine!

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Seriously such a pain...! Let's go!

Overwhelmed by Biwa Hayahide's orderly 
logic, the Umamusume walked away.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... What a troublesome bunch. 
Acting as if they own the track and trying 
to take it over.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry for causing trouble.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, this is no trouble at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, don't stay out too late. 
Make sure to eat a proper dinner once 
you're back at the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I-I already know that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, fine then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, Trainer. I've kept you 
waiting.
choice_data_list: The theory really came in handy, huh!

The theory really came in handy, didn't 
it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, Trainer. I've kept you 
waiting.
choice_data_list: The theory really came in handy, huh!

The theory really came in handy, didn't 
it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? I only acted the way I 
usually do, though...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Still, if there's one thing I can say—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When dealing with emotional people, logic 
is always the most effective approach.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If you do that, they'll find it too 
bothersome and back off on their own.

Biwa Hayahide seemed just a little prouder 
of her theories than usual.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it actually came in handy in an 
unexpected way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I sometimes think of myself as inflexible 
for overthinking things logically, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"If it means I can help a friend, then 
perhaps this could be considered a fine 
strength of mine after all. Heheh."

By helping her friend, Biwa Hayahide 
seemed to gain even more confidence in her 
theories.
